leo.headline: Sell the documented restoration, not just the bike.
leo.summary: Demand for classic steel bikes is steady, and buyers fear hidden faults in private listings. A shop that shows every hour and part can charge for that certainty.

market_facts.fact: Unrestored steel road frames often sell second-hand for under €150.
Fully restored classic road bikes commonly sell for €350 to €700.
A full restoration takes an experienced mechanic roughly 8 to 12 hours.
Boxed bike courier delivery within Spain usually costs €40 to €70.

memo.purpose: An online shop for restored classic steel road bikes, for riders who want character without the risk.
memo.problem: Used bikes from private listings often hide faults that cost money in the first month. Riders who love classic frames rarely have the time or tools to restore one.
memo.insight: Buyers pay for certainty, not nostalgia. Publishing the hours and parts of every restoration makes a used bike feel as safe as a new one.
memo.verdict_line: Thin but testable: break-even is 27 bikes a month and the plan reaches 26, only if a restoration stays under 10 hours.
